subject: [PATCH 1/8] nfsd: clear NFSD_NET_UP before dropping the generic resource reference

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch fixes a potential issue in the NFS server code where NFSD_NET_UP is left set after dropping the generic resource reference, causing inconsistencies when accessing host-wide file cache and NFSv4 tables. The fix involves clearing NFSD_NET_UP before dropping the reference to ensure that the bit never claims the resources are available once they may already be gone. This change does not introduce any functional changes but rather ensures a consistent state in the system.
